title: Cumulative Updates for Business Central – versions
summary: This post lists cumulative updates available for all versions of Dynamics 365 Business Central on-premises, from version 29 (2026 wave 2) through version 13 (2018 wave 2). Updates include hotfixes for all countries and localized versions, with the latest updates recommended to address vulnerabilities and bugs.
key_points: Each cumulative update replaces the earlier updates for its Business Central version.
Always install the latest update, because some updates also fix vulnerabilities.
Updates contain hotfixes for all countries plus hotfixes for specific local versions.
On-premises versions v26 to v29 (2025 wave 1 to 2026 wave 2) are still updated.
Versions v13 to v25 are listed as no longer updated; links to their update lists remain available.

quotes.text: These updates replace previously released updates for each version of Business Central.

quotes.text: Some updates additionally fix vulnerabilities, so the latest update should always be installed.
